name: KINS 5110
title: Leadership, Administration, and Professional Development in Athletic Training
description: The course will cover concepts for student's majoring in athletic training regarding professional development and healthcare administration and organization. The lecture and discussion format of the course will include topics related to personnel management, leadership, daily operations, finance, facility design, information management, workshop development, interviewing skills, ethics and ethical decision-making, organizational structure, work-place culture, among other topics that pertain to the profession of athletic training.
